pr_title: backupccl: remove index/bytes columns from backup/restore return stmt
pr_body:
This removes the index entries and bytes columns from the return result of a backup/restore/import. This columns do not inform the user of anything useful and only serve to mislead them.

Fixes: #133053

Epic: None

Release note (backward-incompatible change): Backup/restore/import statements no longer return index entries and bytes backed up/restored.
pr_comments:
It looks like your PR touches production code but doesn't add or edit any test code. Did you consider adding tests to your PR?

issue_context.title: backupccl: remove indexes and bytes column from return stmt of backup and restore
issue_context.body:
these two columns don't inform the user of anything and only mislead them. the bytes column in particular shows the logical bytes backed up and restored, which the user should never be thinking about. 

Jira issue: CRDB-43442

review_comments: As per [this discussion](https://cockroachlabs.slack.com/archives/C01RX2G8LT1/p1730999089400029), `bytes` is still considered an important column for `IMPORT` jobs. May want to create a separate PR to remove the `index_rows` column though, although not too important as of right now,
